tools.name: create_poll
tools.description: Create a Pickly poll to help a group decide something together (where to eat, which date, what to watch) and get a link to share in the group chat. Nobody needs an account to vote.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Read the current standings of a Pickly poll: who's winning, by how much, and whether voting has closed.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_poll · Public sink: create_poll.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_poll · Public sink: create_poll

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
